crossRefs.note: For the body is not one member, but many.

parallels.note: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you…
If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you…
because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

translations.web: If they were all one member, where would the body be?
translations.bsb: If they were all one part, where would the body be?
translations.kjv: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
translations.asv: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
